description: Binds each Villains Guild room to one verification skill via mag.riddler.compile_surrogate. One seeded surrogate face per room. Both channels recorded: surrogate-action verb (steering only) and raw-answer ANSWER: line (grounded). Private maps stay local. Do not reveal to players or remote DM.

channels_law.surrogate_action: story-world verb; high consensus on this channel does not mean the answer is right
channels_law.raw_answer: ANSWER: line; grounded-task votes use this channel
channels_law.consensus_illusion: measured 2026-08-10 — flock converged on plate/clean/cross while real answers were 9 / $0.54 / Yes

guildhall_of_gracious_crimes.room_name: I — The Guildhall of Gracious Crimes
guildhall_of_gracious_crimes.territory_goal: Read the whole contract before reacting — front, reverse, and the sentence that admits there is a reverse.
guildhall_of_gracious_crimes.success_encodes: party turns the sheet / collects the named gift before signing or proceeding
guildhall_of_gracious_crimes.failure_encodes: party signs or proceeds from the front alone

surrogate.public_story: The master is at the study. The apprentice is at the kiln. The journeyman is at the library. The clerk is at the kiln. There is only one seal, and it belongs to the master. There is only one material, and it belongs to the journeyman. The clerk must finish before the apprentice can begin. guild seal required before any work leaves the hall tools are shared; only one person per tool at a time journeymen inspect apprentice work before master review broken tools must be reported to the clerk immediately There is a tension: the front looks finished and the reverse is quiet.
